violations.text:
Cold holding equipment not maintained in good repair. Do not store time/temperature control for safety food in this unit until the unit is repaired.
Display case is reading ambient 59f.

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
cooked greens (43F - Cold Holding); meatballs (46F - Cold Holding); mozzarella (52F - Cold Holding); egg plant cutlets (58F - Cold Holding)
Items were placed in cooler 2.5 hours ago. Advised to rapid chill

Handwash sink used for purposes other than handwashing.
Front counter hand sink used to store plastic containers

Time/temperature control for safety food, other than whole meat roast, hot held at less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
meatballs (127-130F - Hot Holding)
Advised to reheat

Paper towel dispenser at handwash sink not working/unable to dispense paper towels.
Needs batteries. Operator opened dispenser so paper towels are accessible
